name: Omni Amelia Island Resort
positioning: Oceanfront resort on the tip of a barrier island in northeastern Florida, officially Omni Amelia Island Resort & Spa, with beach, golf, tennis, a spa and marshland trails
best_for: Families who want pools, a splash pad and a nature center
Golfers and tennis or pickleball players
Travelers who want beach time plus trails, kayaking and paddleboarding

facts.text: The resort sits on the tip of a barrier island in northeastern Florida.
The resort overlooks the white sands of Fernandina Beach and the Atlantic Ocean.
Guests have access to 3.5 miles of uncrowded beaches.
Guest rooms and suites have furnished balconies with ocean views.
The grounds have Spanish moss-adorned live oaks.
The resort has 36 holes of championship golf plus a 10-hole short course.
The resort has 23 Har-Tru tennis courts and 7 pickleball courts.
The spa is nature-inspired, with a courtyard featuring water features.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes and an indoor lap pool.
Kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing and adventure tours are offered.
Omni Hotels & Resorts acquired the former Amelia Inn in 2010.
The Sprouting Project is the resort's sustainable greenhouse and garden operation, which has beehives.

highlights.text: The pool deck includes a pool reserved for adults, a family pool and a splash pad.
The spa's signature Quartz Sand Table massage has the guest lie on warm sand.
The nature center offers a chance to see turtles, snakes and Buddy the Macaw.
Oceanfront rooms are in the Sunrise wing, with access to FloraBelle and the Sunrise beach boardwalk.
The resort has over 7 miles of walking, jogging and biking trails.

considerations.text: The Fernandina Beach Historic District is about a 20 minute drive north of the resort.
There is no food service on the beach.
Self-parking is not available during Amelia Island Concours Week, typically held in the first or second week of March.
